text_block_list.text: —Shinko Windy had achieved total dominance over the dirt mile GⅠ races.

"Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun," "Mile Championship Nambu Hai,"
"February Stakes," "Kashiwa Kinen"...
She took 1st place in all of them!
Public opinion has shifted significantly. Even within the academy, attention is skyrocketing...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
Hard rice crackers, Ninjatico, and
brown sugar karinto look delicious too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, it's Windy-chan!
She's been on a crazy winning streak lately, hasn't she...!?
Hehehe, wonder what she's gonna buy~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Dober-san and
Groove-san are over there too!
Aren't you super curious about... what strong girls do every day?!

—Where they were pointing stood
the "Empress" Air Groove, and the earnest
Mejiro family Umamusume, Mejiro Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! Am I drawing attention, somehow...?
It's unsettling being watched...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. In the end,
it's all thanks to your amazing track record."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A true champion must also possess the capacity to shoulder the spotlight.
For example—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! Are you curious~?!
About Windy-chan's favorite snack!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, now I'm curious~!
Wait, is that the secret to strength? I'm gonna buy one too~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoa, to think something I bought would actually sell...! It's like I'm a celebrity! Ni-shi-shi-shi♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? It's Dober and Air Groove-nodan.
How are ya feelin'-nodan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wait, why is Dober sulking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's nothing...
It's not like I'm pouting or anything..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... how do you get used to
being the center of attention?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...? Fine...???
Or rather, is it really fine...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It is fun!
Having everyone watch makes me feel great~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fun... huh... Hmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, being able to think like that must take...
an extraordinary amount of mental strength.
...It's truly incredible.”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy Dober! And everyone~!
What are you talking about~?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuus☆★
Did I hear someone say "getting attention"?!
Lots of people have been watching me lately too!☆

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Let us treat those gazes as an 'honor.' Take pride in yourself for achieving such great results...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I see.
If it's about feeling 'pride', maybe I understand...

Jumping into the conversation was...
the American-raised sprinter,
Taiki Shuttle.

The somewhat mysterious and sparkly Umamusume, Marvelous Sunday.
And Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, all the super-hyped, crazy strong Umamusume
are all gathered here! Their auras are insane...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"A super-duper strong Umamusume...!
Is it Windy-chan? Does everyone think Windy-chan is like that too?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's right. You've already conquered
the GⅠ dirt mile route yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She was always playing pranks, and whenever we met,
all I did was scold her... but to think she'd go this far...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You really did well.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Air Groove praised me!
That's so rare!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yaaaay!
Windy-chan really is the greatest, da noda~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm a genius~♪ I'm the scaaaaariest~♪
Hmm-hmm-huhu-huuun~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Honestly... So restless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. If only I could take things
that easy-going too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, you guys! I'm in a great mood, so I'll share the snacks I just bought!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I know! We should eat outside together!
We'll have a sweets party as a
"Celebration of Windy-chan" party, nodaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A sweets party!?
That sounds totally MARVELOUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great~! Since we're here,
let's roast some marshmallows~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... After all, we're all comrades who have fought our hardest. Taking a breather like this once in a while is nice♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and go--!
It's a race, you know----!!
Thanks to her prowess, Shinko Windy had somehow earned herself a place among the strongest competitors even off the track!
